label: CalTopo → TAK
info:
Streams a CalTopo map into TAK: markers with matching TAK icons, lines and shapes, and live-tracked team members. Items deleted in CalTopo are deleted in TAK.

Data: CalTopo (https://caltopo.com/). Updates every 60 seconds.

Needs: A CalTopo map shared so that anyone with the link can view it.

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Put your map ID (the code after caltopo.com/m/) in the Fetch JSON node's URL, replacing YOUR_MAP_ID.
3. Rename the CalTopo Engine function to CalTopo Engine - <your map name>. That name becomes the map label in TAK.
4. Optional: list team members to show as live positions in LIVE_TRACK_NAMES at the top of the engine.
5. For more maps, copy the inject, Fetch JSON and engine nodes and give each its own map ID and name.
6. The icon paths are for standard TAK iconsets. Markers whose icon isn't installed on your server show as a plain dot.
7. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/caltopo-streamer

// CalTopo JSON -> CoT engine
// Input: msg.payload = CalTopo map JSON (GET https://caltopo.com/api/v1/map/<MAP_ID>/since/0)
// Every CalTopo feature has a permanent id, so TAK UIDs are stable:
//   CalTopo-<MAP_KEY>-<feature id>   (lines: -Line-, live position: -LiveTrack-)
// Features that disappear from the map are deleted from TAK (t-x-d-d).
try {
    function esc(s) {
        return String(s == null ? "" : s)
            .replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/</g, "<")
            .replace(/>/g, ">").replace(/"/g, """).replace(/'/g, "'");
    }
    let channelName = "Cal/SAR Topo Feed";
    let liveTrackFolderMatch = /live\s*track/i;          // features in a "Live Tracks" folder are tracked people
    let subjectPhoneRe = /^subject\d*\s+(\d{10,})$/i;    // SMS Locator convention: "subject1 6155551234"
    // Roster of live-tracked team members (their track LineStrings get a current-position PLI)
    let LIVE_TRACK_NAMES = [];   // e.g. ["J Smith", "A Jones"]
    let liveTrackNamesLower = LIVE_TRACK_NAMES.map(function (n) { return n.trim().toLowerCase(); });
    let LIVE_STALE_WINDOW_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;           // position icon only while the track moved in the last 15 min
    const STALE_MS = 2 * 60 * 1000;                      // CoT stale time (must exceed the poll interval)

    // ---- Per-map identity (from this node's name: "CalTopo Engine - <map>") ----
    const nodeLabel = String(node.name || "").replace(/^CalTopo (JSON |KML to CoT )?Engine\s*-?\s*/i, "").trim();
    const MAP_TITLE = nodeLabel;
    const MAP_KEY = nodeLabel.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "").slice(0, 32) || ("node" + node.id.slice(-6));
    const LIVE_STATE_KEY = "calTopoLiveTrackState_" + MAP_KEY;
    const SENT_KEY = "calTopoSentUids_" + MAP_KEY;
    const SYMBOLS_SEEN = {};

    const res = msg.payload && msg.payload.result;
    if (!res || !res.state || !Array.isArray(res.state.features)) {
        const why = (msg.payload && (msg.payload.message || msg.payload.status)) || ("HTTP " + msg.statusCode);
        node.status({ fill: "red", shape: "ring", text: MAP_KEY + ": bad CalTopo response (" + String(why).slice(0, 40) + ")" });
        return null;   // no deletes on a failed fetch
    }
    const features = res.state.features;

    let liveTrackState = flow.get(LIVE_STATE_KEY) || {};
    let nowMs = Date.now();
    let timeIso = new Date(nowMs).toISOString();
    let staleIso = new Date(nowMs + STALE_MS).toISOString();
    let outMessages = [];
    let sentUids = [];
    let processedPoints = 0, processedLines = 0, processedShapes = 0;

    // Folder id -> title (for "Live Tracks" folder detection)
    const folderTitle = {};
    features.forEach(function (f) { if (f && f.properties && f.properties.class === "Folder") { folderTitle[f.id] = String(f.properties.title || ""); } });

    let ICON_INFO = {
        "hut":               { cotType: "a-f-G-U-C", color: -16711936, label: "Shelter" },
        "pre-shutoff-water": { cotType: "a-f-G-U-C", color: -16776961, label: "Potable Water" },
        "usar-20":           { cotType: "b-m-p-s-m", color: -23296,    label: "Road/Route Hazard" },
        "wifi":              { cotType: "a-f-G-U-U-S", color: -16711936, label: "Comms / Starlink" },
        "anchorage":         { cotType: "b-m-p-s-m", color: -16776961, label: "Boat Ramp / Anchorage" },
        "evac-staying":      { cotType: "a-f-G-U-C", color: -256,      label: "Shelter in Place" },
        "point":             { cotType: "b-m-p-s-m", color: null,      label: "" }
    };
    let DEFAULT_INFO = { cotType: "b-m-p-w", color: -1, label: "" }; // confirmed valid Waypoint type

// ---- CalTopo icon -> CloudTAK/ATAK iconset mapping -------------------------
// Every path was verified against the iconsets installed on CloudTAK
// (a CloudTAK server) on 2026-10-25. Order of resolution:
//   1. exact CalTopo symbol name (USERICON_MAP)

            const uid = "CalTopo-" + MAP_KEY + "-Line-" + f.id;
            const links = pts.map(function (q) { return '<link point="' + q.lat.toFixed(6) + ',' + q.lon.toFixed(6) + ',0"/>'; }).join("");
            let extra = '<strokeColor value="' + strokeColor + '"/><strokeWeight value="' + strokeWeight + '"/>';
            if (g.type === "Polygon") { extra += '<fillColor value="' + cssToArgb(p.fill || p.stroke || "#ff0000", p["fill-opacity"] !== undefined ? p["fill-opacity"] : 0.1) + '"/>'; processedShapes++; }
            else { processedLines++; }
            const remarks = esc([g.type === "Polygon" ? "Area" : "Track/Route", description, "CalTopo-TAK Sync Layer"].filter(Boolean).join(" | "));
            emit(uid, cot(uid, "u-d-f", pts[0].lat, pts[0].lon,
                '<contact callsign="' + esc(markerName) + '"/>' + links + extra + '<remarks>' + remarks + '</remarks>'));

            // ---- Live position for roster members / Live Tracks folder, only while moving
            if (g.type === "LineString" && (inLiveFolder || liveTrackNamesLower.indexOf(markerName.toLowerCase()) !== -1)) {
                const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
                const coordKey = last.lat.toFixed(6) + "," + last.lon.toFixed(6);
                const prev = liveTrackState[f.id];
                let isCurrentlyLive = false;
                if (!prev) { liveTrackState[f.id] = { coordKey: coordKey, lastChangedAt: null }; }
                else if (prev.coordKey !== coordKey) { liveTrackState[f.id] = { coordKey: coordKey, lastChangedAt: nowMs }; isCurrentlyLive = true; }
                else if (prev.lastChangedAt !== null) { isCurrentlyLive = (nowMs - prev.lastChangedAt) <= LIVE_STALE_WINDOW_MS; }
                if (isCurrentlyLive) {
                    const posUid = "CalTopo-" + MAP_KEY + "-LiveTrack-" + f.id;
                    emit(posUid, cot(posUid, "a-f-G-U-C-I", last.lat, last.lon,
                        '<contact callsign="' + esc(markerName) + '"/>' +
                        '<remarks>' + esc("Live Track - Current Position | CalTopo-TAK Sync Layer") + '</remarks>'));
                }
            }
        }
    });

    // ---- Deletes: anything sent last poll that is no longer on the map --------
    const prevSent = flow.get(SENT_KEY) || [];
    const nowSet = {}; sentUids.forEach(function (u) { nowSet[u] = true; });
    let deleted = 0;
    if (features.length > 0) {
        prevSent.forEach(function (u) {
            if (nowSet[u]) { return; }
            deleted++;
            outMessages.push({ payload: '<?xml version="1.0" standalone="yes"?>' +
                '<event version="2.0" uid="' + esc(u) + '-delete-' + nowMs + '" type="t-x-d-d" time="' + timeIso + '" start="' + timeIso + '" stale="' + new Date(nowMs + 60000).toISOString() + '" how="h-g-i-g-o">' +
                '<point lat="0" lon="0" hae="0" ce="9999999" le="9999999"/>' +
                '<detail><link uid="' + esc(u) + '" relation="none" type="none"/><__forcedelete/>' +
                '<marti><dest name="' + esc(channelName) + '"/></marti></detail></event>\n' });
        });
        flow.set(SENT_KEY, sentUids);
    }
    flow.set(LIVE_STATE_KEY, liveTrackState);
    flow.set("calTopoSymbolsSeen_" + MAP_KEY, SYMBOLS_SEEN);

    node.status({ fill: "green", shape: "dot", text: MAP_KEY + ": " + processedPoints + " markers, " + processedLines + " lines" + (processedShapes ? ", " + processedShapes + " areas" : "") + (deleted ? ", " + deleted + " deleted" : "") + " @ " + new Date(nowMs).toLocaleTimeString() });
    return [outMessages];
} catch (err) {
    node.error("CalTopo JSON engine exception: " + err.message, msg);
    return null;
}
